test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On : 1 June 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.**

Maverick
solution: The correct answer is **option 3 i.e. Conformist.** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • "**Maverick " **means a person who does not behave or think like everyone else, but who has independent, unusual opinions. (एक अपरंपरागत या स्वतंत्र दिमाग वाला व्यक्ति।) • "**Conformist" **means a person who behaves in the same way as most other people and who does not want to be different. (स्वीकृत व्यवहार या स्थापित प्रथाओं के अनुरूप; पारंपरिक; नैष्ठिक) • Hence, it is clear that **Maverick **and **Conformist **are opposite in meaning. • Thus, the correct answer is **option 3.** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** • **Custodian **means a person who looks after something, especially a museum, library, etc.(रखवाली करने वाला) • **Versatility **means ability to adapt or be adapted to many different functions or activities.(बहुमुखी प्रतिभा) • **Brilliance **means great brightness; radiance; exceptional talent or intelligence.(चमक; प्रतिभा) 44:T9de, The correct answer is **option 4 i.e. Mercenary.**
